title: Abstract Rose on Black
coreRelationships: The white, glossy rose form stands in stark contrast against the deep black background.
The swirling lines and sharp edges within the white form create a sense of dynamic movement and texture.
The abstract nature of the rose allows for interpretation, blurring the line between organic and artificial.
The small, white text block at the bottom provides a counterpoint to the large, central rose image.
reuseFormula: Generate a high-contrast, abstract white rose with a glossy, liquid texture against a solid black background. Position it centrally and slightly rotated. Add a small, white, center-aligned, all-caps sans-serif text block at the bottom, with 'ADVISORY' in bold and slightly larger than the other lines, separated by a thin horizontal rule.
